Commentary.Commentary: The hosts' first mission would be to tackle this tricky period before the end of day's play without losing any wickets. Then, take it from there and come out tomorrow to try and get something out of this game. The final innings of this Test is about to begin. Don't go anywhere...

Misbah-ul-Haq is happy with the lead his team has got and has called his players back. After the tea break, the visitors lost Sarfraz Ahmed and Asad Shafiq in quick succession. But a good 61-run stand between Mohammad Amir and Yasir Shah has seen Pakistan set a target of 304. The West Indian bowlers were made to toil hard but they have only themselves to blame as they were quite sloppy in the field and that allowed the visitors to run away with the game. Alzarri Joseph broke that frustrating partnership and was certainly the best of the lot for his side.
SIX! Muscled! Floated delivery on the stumps, Hasan Ali gets down on one knee and clubs it over long on for a maximum. Brilliant hit, lead now crosses 300! PAKISTAN HAVE DECLARED!
Lucky again! Yasir steps out of the crease to slog it over the leg side but the ball turns, takes the outside edge and goes over a leaping first slip fielder. They pick up three this time.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up outside off, Yasir Shah gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it through point to pick up a boundary. Declaration batting, this!

Dropped! Floats it up outside off, turning away as Ali looks to hit it across the line but gets a top edge towards backward point. Gabriel comes running in and dives forward to catch it but the ball pops out of his hands. They run one.
Tossed up delivery, Ali swings but wears it on the body.
Declaration seems to be around the corner. The Pakistan dugout seems to be ready, Sarfraz is seen wearing his gloves and preparing to take the field.
Slower through the air around middle, Yasir gets across and paddles it towards backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Boom! Alzarri doles out a low full toss on off, Ali backs away and bashes it straight down the ground for a boundary.

Top edge but safe! Slower length ball on middle, Hasan Ali swipes across the line but is undone by the lack of pace this time. Gets a big top edge towards deep mid-wicket where Bishoo completely misjudges the ball and it dies down safely. Two more added to the total.
Back of a length on off, Ali punches it uppishly through covers and comes back for a couple.
Hasan Ali to bat next.

OUT! Bishoo holds onto the catch! And West Indies finally manage to break this stand! Joseph hurls a length ball on off, Amir makes room and slaps it hard. It goes straight to Bishoo at short extra cover who almost loses the ball in the sun as the ball pops out of his hands but he does well to take it on the second attempt.
Serves it a bit wide outside off, dabbed away towards point.
Angling across from over the wicket, Amir smacks it through extra cover and comes back for a couple.
Alzarri Joseph returns to the attack.
Floats it up outside off, Shah looks to play the reverse sweep but fails to connect.
Yasir comes forward to defend, expecting it to be a leg break but it's the googly. The batsman is beaten all ends up.
Spinning away from a length outside off, Shah looks to cut but then lets it be.
Loopy delivery on the stumps, Yasir fails to put bat on ball and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up wider outside off, Amir slog sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Sees Amir skipping down the track, Bishoo bowls a quicker one on middle and leg, cramps Amir for room. The batsman chops it past the stumps as Dowrich collects it with his left hand.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Comes down the track once more and digs it out through the right of the bowler for a single.
Comes down the track and digs it out for nothing.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Yasir turns inside his crease and works it down on the leg side.
Dropped short by Chase, around off, Shah goes deep inside his crease and punches it a bit square through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Tossed up from around the wicket, on middle and off, Amir leans forward and pushes it to the covers for an easy run.
Very full on the stumps, knocked down to long on for a single. 16 runs off the over!
50-run stand between Amir and Shah!
FOUR! Amir into the action now! Sinks down and slog sweeps it off the meat of the bat to the mid-wicket fence for another boundary.
Stays back and hits it down to long on for a single.
Flighted outside off, driven past extra cover for another couple.

In the air... safe again! Bishoo slows it through the air around off, Shah once again looks to go big. Mistimes it towards long off as the ball falls safely. Two runs taken. West Indies look frustrated!
SIX! Nailed it! Flighted delivery around middle and off, Yasir sits down on one knee and nails the slog sweep over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen. What a hit! Take that, Bishoo!
Amir drives this full ball towards the cover region.

NOT OUT! Waste of a review! Chase sends in a loopy ball around off, it straightens a bit after pitching as Amir is beaten on the poke. Dowrich collects and starts to appeal for a caught behind. Nothing from the umpire. Dowrich asks for the review and replays show there's daylight between bat and ball.
A review for a caught behind against Mohammad Amir is reviewed by West Indies.

Edged and dropped! Dowrich drops it! Chase gives it a nice amount of flight outside off, Amir looks to fetch it from outside the off stump line but gets a top edge. Dowrich fails to gather and the fielder at first slip is daydreaming as he doesn't even go after it when the ball was still in the air after bursting out of the keeper's gloves.
Full ball on off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Drilled! Tossed up outside off, Amir drills it through covers for a boundary. Went hard at it!
Chase fires it full on off, Amir comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Outside off, driven  down to long on for one.
From over the wicket, gets some bounce as Amir defends it in front of FSL.
Drags the length short and Yasir is quick to go back and pull it through mid-wicket for a single.

Wicket off a no ball! Bishoo what have you done? I die a little everytime when a spinner oversteps! That's just unacceptable! Nonetheless, Yasir Shah gets a reprieve! Bishoo pushes it quicker through the air around off, Shah looks to defend but the ball bounces off the deck, kisses the gloves and Dowrich takes a sharp catch behind. West Indies celebrate but the umpire checks for the no ball. Replays show Bishoo has overstepped.
Skids through the surface, Shah leaves it alone.
Short and turning away, Shah plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Slower through the air, around off, Shah defends it down.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes forward and defends it with an open face bat towards first slip.
Fuller on off, blocked down off the front foot.
Drifting in from around off, Amir defends it down gently.
Shah comes down the track and digs it out back to the bowler who fails to stop it with his right hand. The ball rolls towards mid on and they take a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, turns away. Amir looks to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls past first slip for a single.
Floated ball outside off, Amir drags it towards mid-wicket and takes a run. That'll be the end of the over.
Mohammad Amir is half-forward and keeps it out confidently.
FOUR! It's short and Amir has not let this one go by. He rocks back and pulls it behind square leg. Beats the man out in the deep and picks up a boundary for doing so.
Gives this some nice flight, Amir leans across and wrists it to mid-wicket. Straight to the fielder so no run taken.
Tossed up outside off, Amir prods forward and meets it with a straight blade.
Some attacking intent from Mohammad Amir. Gives the charge to Bishoo who is coming from around the wicket, looks to slog it over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tosses it right up there, outside off, driven to mid off for a brisk single.
Back to around the wicket, it's bouncing and turning from around off, Amir stands his ground and taps it down in front of silly point.
Short, still loopy and turning in, Shah goes back and pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Over the wicket now, it's dropped on a driving length, Yasir plants his front foot forward, gets closer to the pitch and blocks.
Flatter and shorter on off, Amir uses his wrists and turns it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Loopy on a full length, from around the wicket, Amir is forward in defense.
Roston Chase comes on to bowl!
Outside off with width on offer, Yasir looks to cut but is beaten by the turn and bounce.
Flat and full on the stumps, played straight back to the bowler.
Back of a driving length, gives enough time to Yasir Shah to adjust and push it to the covers.
Quicker through the air on off, Shah off his back foot keeps this one out.
Similar ball, on a flatter trajectory, ends up beating the outside edge again.
Spinning away from around off, Yasir hangs his bat out but the ball beats the outside edge.
Fuller on off, driven off the toe end towards point.
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended down off the back foot.
Short of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller and angling in, Amir misses the flick and is hit on the pads.
Short and outside off, slapped straight to the man at point.
Shortish outside off, tapped towards gully for a single.
Fuller around middle, drilled back to the bowler by Amir.

In the air... safe! Touch flatter around middle and off, turning away as Yasir Shah goes back to pull but the ball stops on him. He flicks it uppishly to the right of Holder at mid on and scampers through for a quick single.
Loops it up on off, Yasir Shah presses forward in defense.
Lures his opposite number into a front foot push and gets the ball to turn away, almost kisses the outside part of the willow before going into Dowrich's gloves.
Fuller around off, Yasir makes room and drives it towards wide mid off.
Tossed up outside off, turning away, Yasir Shah leaves it alone.
Devendra Bishoo is back on for another spell.
Prods forward to this full ball and defends it down on the pitch gently.
Low full toss at the base of off stump, Mohammad digs it out.
Good length ball, from around the wicket, Amir meets it with a straight blade.
Short and angling in, Shah tucks it uppishly past the man at square leg for a single.
Very full on off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Short on middle and off, Yasir Shah hops to defend it down on the leg side.
Very full on off, jammed out towards cover.
Comes from over the wicket and angles it in from around off, Mohammad defends it down.
Short and outside off, it kicks off the deck, Amir opens a bit but still manages to dab it between first slip and the keeper for a couple of runs.
Full toss, wide outside off, Amir shoulders his arms.
Very full and angling in, Amir looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side.
Angles in a length delivery on off, Amir stays back and defends it towards covers.
Drinks are on the field!
Short ball from Holder, Shah does well to rise on his toes and keep it down.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Shout for a leg before which is turned down. Angling down leg, Shah looks to flick but it goes off the pads down to fine leg for a couple of leg byes.
Stays inside his crease and keeps this one out solidly.
Outside off on a good length, played to point.
Short of a good length outside off, Shah comes down the track and with an angled bat, steers it towards gully. Thinks of taking the run but then decides against it.
Full and slow outside off, waits for it and pushes it to point. The fielder there dives and half-stops it which allows the batsmen to cross over.
On the pads and it's put away. This is smart batting from Yasir Shah. He just clips this over mid-wicket, doesn't hit it too hard but it's enough to clear the infield. Picks up a double.
Fuller length delivery very close to the off stick, pushes off the front foot to cover-point.
Back of a length on off, blocked on the off side in front of covers.

Direct hit and he would have been gone! Yasir Shah survives. He opens the face and dabs it towards gully where the fielder dives and parries it to backward point. The latter has a shy at the striker's end where Shah dives to get back in. He would have been gone if there was a direct hit.
Fuller length ball, right on off, Yasir stays perfectly behind the line and pushes it back down the track.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the attack.
Good length delivery from Joseph, blocked from within the crease.
Shaping across once more, on a back of a length this time, pushed away down on the off side.
Spears across a full delivery, going away well outside off, Mohammad Amir lets it be.
Coming back in on a back of a length, it's turned 'round the corner for an easy single.
Full outside off, shaping back in, Shah has nothing to do with that one.
Full ball to Yasir, driven past mid on by the batsman for a couple of runs.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Closes the face of the bat and works it to mid-wicket.
Loopy and fullish length, swept away and it hits the man at short leg. Bounces off him to the keeper who whips the bails off. Appeals for a stumping but nothing from the square leg umpire.
No ball! Bishoo oversteps this time, no ball called. Tosses it up there and it raps Amir on the pads as he looks to play at it.
Driven to mid on this time. Another dot ball.
Loopy on a good length, around off, it's driven to mid off for nothing.
Tossed up on off, turning in, Amir comes forward and works it past FSL.
FOUR! Yasir Shah shows how it's done. It's full and attacking the stumps, he drives it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Yasir Shah looks to hit it away but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Yasir Shah to take the bat next for Pakistan.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Asad Shafiq is done by the slowness of the wicket here. Seam up, it stopped a bit and probably became Asad Shafiq's undoing. He is into the shot too early and ends up chipping it straight back to Joseph, who takes a good return catch.
Shortens the length on this occasion, pounds it outside off, it's coming back in off the deck as Shafiq leaves it alone.
On the fuller side of things, outside off, Shafiq plants his front foot forward and drives it straight to the man at covers.
Good length delivery just around off, a solid defensive shot presented by Asad Shafiq.
Stays back and keeps it out with the full face of the bat.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven to mid on by the left-hander.
Loopy leg break on off, Amir fails to read the turn and the ball lobs off the pads. It goes behind over leg slip but no run is taken.
Stays behind to this flatter ball and keeps it out.
Loopy ball on off, fuller in length, driven to mid off.
Continues from around the wicket to Amir, it's tossed up around off, it's blocked off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Short delivery into the body, Shafiq pulls it through backward square leg. Nobody out in the deep so the ball will go across the rope.
Short ball outside off, dabbed away to point with an open face.
Back of a length delivery, kept out off the back foot.
Well played, Shafiq. He waits for this to come to him, camps back and cuts it perfectly between point and cover. Gets two runs for it.
Fullish in length and on the off stump line, Shafiq keeps it out solidly.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
From around the wicket, Bishoo bowls it on a length. There's some serious turn and bounce as Amir goes back to cut. Hits him on the gloves and then dies down.
Full ball and it's flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full toss on the stumps, swept through square leg for a single.
Not much spin on this occasion, on off with some good bounce, Shafiq goes back and cuts it to point.
Loopy leg spinner on off, Shafiq comes ahead and leaves the ball spinning away from him.
On the shorter side of the length, on the fifty stump line, easy leave for the southpaw.
Play and a miss! On a back of a length, well outside off, Amir looks to cut fiercely but can't connect.
Comes from around the wicket and hurls it on a length outside off, Mohammad Amir off his back foot punches it towards cover-point.
Mohammad Amir will be the new man in.

OUT! This is good bowling from Alzarri Joseph. Sees Sarfraz Ahmed walking down the track and bowls it short. Takes the pace off it too which makes Sarfraz play the pull shot early. It goes off the top edge and lobs behind, where Shane Dowrich runs back and takes a dolly. Another timely wicket for West Indies.
Comes from wide of the crease and fires it full, angling in around off, Sarfraz pushes this straight to short cover.
Straighter in line, on middle and leg, worked away to mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Shafiq chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Makes room to this loopy ball, is a bit cramped for room as he cuts but still manages to get it to covers.
Asad Shafiq plays this to point with an angled bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spins away from around off, on a driving length, Shafiq plants his front foot forward and lets it be.
Short and turning away from around off, Shafiq goes back and pulls it away through mid-wicket for a double.

Oh, that was a mild scare for the batsman. It's full on off, slower one, Sarfraz is early into the shot as he flicks this. It's in the air but only for a brief moment. Bounces on to the mid-wicket fielder present there.
Wide outside off, Sarfraz cuts it past point and gets two runs for it.
Bit too straight. banged on a shorter length, Asad Shafiq hops across and tucks it through backward square leg. Won't go all the way but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length delivery, very close to the off stump, blocked.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Shafiq shoulders his arms to this one.
Wide! Joseph serves this way, way, way outside off. Shafiq lets it be. The umpire raises his hands to signal it as a wide.
Alzarri Joseph to bowl from the other end!

He's away without wasting any time. Wouldn't expect anything else from Sarfraz Ahmed. Short and outside off, he rocks back and pulls it through the right of the mid on fielder and picks up two runs for it.

We are back for the final session of the day. Sarfraz Ahmed will join Asad Shafiq in the middle. The goal will be to swell the lead as much and as quickly as possible. Devendra Bishoo will bowl the pending ball of his over.
... DAY 4, EVENING SESSION ...

The visitors added 63 runs for the loss of 3 wickets and the lead has crossed the 200-mark. West Indies would want to make further inroads from this point and keep the lead to as minimum as possible. Pakistan would probably like to score briskly and try and get a result on the final day. The last session should be filled with action. It'll begin shortly, don't go anywhere...

A rather emotional session for Pakistan. Two of their legends played their last ever knock in Test cricket. Both were dismissed in quick succession. Not the way they would have liked to bow out, but they can keep their heads held high for everything they've done. Nothing to be disappointed about.

OUT! Younis Khan's stay at the crease and in the international arena comes to an end! What a reception for the veteran! The crowd is up on its feet to laud the Pakistan legend! His teammates give him a similar guard of honor just like they gave one to Misbah. Bishoo bowls a loopy delivery on the stumps, Younis gets down and across to take it on the full. In his attempt to play the sweep, he manages to get a top edge and Powell at short fine leg sprints across to his left and takes a diving one-handed stunner. All his life he's nailed the sweep shot, but it's the same shot that sees him bid adieu to his career. What a player, what a wonderful player! TEA ON DAY 4!
Bowls a flipper around middle, Khan brings his pad and bat together in defense but misses and is hit on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Leg break outside off, Shafiq cuts it through covers for one.
Beaten! Tossed up around middle, it turns away sharply as Shafiq lunges forward to defend but is lucky to not nick one behind.
On a length and outside off, dabbed towards third man.

Five Wides! Bonus runs! Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, it kicks off the surface as Younis lets it sail over him. Dowrich behind the stumps fails to collect it and the ball races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Shortish on off, Khan gets on top of the bounce to defend it towards covers.
Pitches it up on off, Khan prods forward to keep it out.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Khan comes out of the crease and tucks it towards the on side.
Fuller and angling in on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Turning away from a length around off, Shafiq defends it off the back foot.
AS has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slider around middle and leg, Asad keeps it out.
Short and around off, stays low, Shafiq punches it towards the cover region.
Pitched on middle and leg, defended off the front foot.
Fuller around middle, swept through backward square leg for a single.
On a length and around middle, Asad Shafiq keeps it out off the back foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Shafiq stays back and defends it down.
Outside off, it's left alone.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Asad Shafiq is the next batsman in.

OUT! Misbah-ul-Haq is done and dusted with Test cricket! He walks off amidst a huge round of applause. Each and every West Indian player walks upto him to shake his hand. Younis Khan hugs him and pats him on the back. Now his teammates give him a guard of honor with their bats keeping skywards. Coming to the dismissal, tossed up delivery around middle and off, Misbah gets down on one knee to slog sweep it but gets a big fat top edge towards the on side. Shane Dowrich calls for it, moves to his left and takes a well-judged catch. Well played Misbah, the cricketing world shall miss you.

Bishoo slows it through the air around middle and off, the ball seems to have stopped on the batsman. Younis Khan goes back to pull but it mistimes it towards short mid-wicket. They look to steal a single as well as the shy is made at the bowler's end but misses as Younis dives to get back in. A single taken.
Misbah waits for the ball to turn away and then punches it through covers for a single.
Loopy outside off, turning away, Misbah defends it off the back foot.
Drops it short on middle, it stays a bit low. Younis Khan goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker through the air outside off, Khan leaves it alone.
Devendra Bishoo to roll his arm.
Misbah lunges forward and drives it straight to short cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length delivery on off, pushed towards point.
High full toss, dipping in, worked through the on side for a single.
Leg bye! Fuller on the pads, Misbah looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads down to fine leg. A leg bye picked up.
Fires in a yorker right at the base of off stump, Misbah jams it out off the outer part of the bat towards wide second slip.
Very full on off, it's driven with the full face of the bat back to the bowler.
Short and angling down leg, Younis leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off, Khan jumps across and defends it towards point.
Fullish outside off, Khan defends it from within his crease.
Fuller and coming in on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, coming back in from outside off, Misbah off his front foot keeps it out towards covers.
On a length and outside off, Khan rides the bounce and pushes it towards covers.
Fuller and angling in, Khan gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Very full on off, jammed out towards the point fielder.
Good length, served on off, blocked into the off side.
Sprays down the leg side, YK misses his flick.
Shuffles a long way across and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
A bit too straight on this occasion, Misbah misses the attempted flick shot and the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side.
Goes wide of the crease and fires in a full length delivery on off, Misbah tries to defend it off the front foot but the ball shapes away at the last moment and he gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller in length and outside off, Misbah shoulders his arms.
Misbah-ul-Haq walks out to bat for the one last time. Jason Holder shows good respect again and shakes his hand. Younis Khan hugs him. The veterans batting together, priceless moment...

OUT! Got him! The decision stands! Shannon Gabriel strikes! From around the wicket, Gabriel angles in a length delivery and it skids in off the deck. Masood tries flicking it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. Gabriel appeals and keeps doing it. The umpire after taking his time raises his finger. Shan takes the review and replays show that Gabriel's front foot is fine and then the Ball-Tracker shows it was in line and would have gone on to clip the middle and leg stump. That is it for Masood.
Shan Masood is given out LBW but he takes the review straightaway. Looks really close...
No ball! Fuller and sprayed down the leg side, Masood misses his flick and it goes to the keeper one the bounce. Gabriel oversteps and will have to reload it.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Masood looks to cut it away but gets a bottom edge besides the pitch.
Prods forward and defends it down on the pitch.
Good length ball, it holds its line after pitching, Khan pokes inside the line and is beaten all ends up.
Fuller and angling in from outside off, defended off the front foot.
Sticks to back of a length on off, Khan punches it a bit uppishly towards the cover fielder.
On a length and outside off, chopped towards the backward point fielder.
Back of a length outside off, Younis Khan defends it off the back foot.
Drinks are on the field...
Going down the leg side, Masood gets a little tickle on this. It goes behind but doesn't carry to the keeper.
Good length delivery which is worked away to mid-wicket.

No ball! To everybody's surprise, it's not because he overstepped his line. Lost control of that, probably slipped out of his hands. Gabriel ends up bowling a high full toss outside off, Younis slaps it aerially towards extra cover. the fielder dives to his right, gets his hands to it but fails to take it.
Full and aiming the base of off stump, driven straight to mid off.
Third man in place now...

FOUR! Streaky but Pakistan won't mind. Runs, especially quick runs, are always welcome. Length ball outside off, Younis Khan looks to cut but gets it off the bottom edge past the gully fielder. No chance for anybody else to stop that and that'll be a boundary.
Short of a length, angling into the body, Younis rises and works it to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length, not troubling at all for the batsman, dabbed with an open face to point from within his crease.

Fuller in length around off, Masood walks across and wrists it towards wide mid on. He wants the run seeing there is a misfield from the man positioned there but Younis still shows his hand to send him back. Quite strange.
Walks across to this one and taps it down square on the leg side. Won't get any run for it though.
Good length ball on off stump, blocked.
Beaten! Scrambled seam from Holder, bowls it full and it goes away off the surface. Shan Masood looks to defend coming forward but is beaten all ends up.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short cover.
Anything reasonably straight and it should be assumed that Shan Masood will work it away on the leg side. It's wristed away to square leg.
Room on offer outside off, frees his arms and cracks it straight to the point fielder.
Bangs in a short ball on the stumps, ducked and evaded rather carefully.
Angling in a full ball on off from wide of the crease. Younis keeps it out with the full face of the bat. His front foot is still while his back foot comes across. Effective nonetheless.
Fractionally straighter in line, it's dropped with soft hands on the on side.

Two more, Younis Khan is looking good in this innings. Playing more freely, with much more fluency. He once again drives it through the covers. If the outfield wasn't so thick, he'd have earned himself a couple of more boundaries by now.
Length delivery on the fourth stump line, Younis Khan drives this on the gap and pierces the gap through the covers. Gets a brace for it.
Cutter outside off, Younis picks it up and places it towards point to retain strike.
Quite straight on middle and leg, kept out from within the crease.

Back of a length delivery outside off, a bit cramped for room but Shan Masood cuts it to point and sets off. Brathwaite is the fielder there and he has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and the run is completed. Had that hit though, would have been quite close.
Angling in on off, Masood goes across and works it to mid-wicket with the angle.
Good length ball once again, outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Continues from around the wicket to Shan Masood, it's on a length outside off. Cut away to point. Dot ball.
Once again it's around off, similar length, dabbed away a bit square on the off side.
Takes some of the pace off this and bowls it on a fuller length, Younis Khan comes ahead and easily deals with it.
Back of a length on off stump, Khan with a slightly opened face dabs it to point.
FOUR! Wide, outside off, width on offer which Younis Khan takes with delight. Slashes this past the diving gully fielder and sends it away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Marginally ahead of a length, outside the line of off stump, pushed away to the covers.
Back of a length angling into the batsman, Younis rises on his toes and works it down in front of mid-wicket.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the attack now.
Very full on off, Masood adjusts well and taps it away to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Walks across to this length ball and works it away to square leg.
Stays back to this short ball and taps it down on the turf.
Good length delivery around off, Masood stays put and blocks it to the mid off fielder.
Jason Holder bowls a length delivery from around the wicket, gets it to angle in on off, Masood ensures he has the line covered when defending this one out.
Jason Holder is into the attack now!
Full on the stumps, driven down to mid on to end the over.

FOUR! Excellent timing, it's right off the middle of the bat. Flighted, full and very slow through the air, Younis Khan drills this through the cover region. The fielder tries chasing it down but fails in his attempt to do so.
Comes slowly to Younis to gets down to play the reverse sweep, misses and it goes off his arm past the diving slip fielder. Two runs signalled by the umpire.
Extremely loopy outside off, driven to the left of the mid off fielder for a couple of good runs.
Kicks off the deck a bit, comes in from outside off, Younis covers the line and withdraws his bat to let it through.
Slower through the air, on off, swept towards short fine leg.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Outside off, played to point. Dot ball.
Short and outside off, rises a bit more Younis expects it to. He goes through with the pull shot but only manages to connect with thin air.
Quite harmless, wide outside off, he doesn't bother himself with it.
Spears it full and way outside off, drives straight to the point fielder.
Shaping back in to the batsman, Younis Khan from deep inside his crease works it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Flighted ball outside off, Khan kneels down and drags the sweeps through backward square leg and picks up one.
Spinning into the batsman, off the pad it's worked away on the leg side.

Ooofff... That's gone right through! It's spinning in a long way from outside off, Younis is forward to defend but the ball sneaks right between bat and pad. Just misses the off stump and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
From around the wicket, Masood goes back to this short delivery and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
That's shot off the surface. Slower the air, short in length, Khan goes back and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Quite loopy for Roston Chase, drops it just back of a driving length, Younis Khan plants his front foot forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and defends.
Stays deep inside his crease and meets it with a straight bat.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Switches the angle and comes from around the wicket, pitches it on a length outside off, left alone.
Full and wide outside off, it's driven a bit square through cover-point. Single taken.
Slightly on the fuller side of things, Khan stays back to this when he should be coming forward. Manages to keep it out off the splice.
Alzarri Joseph comes from wide of the crease and angles in a length delivery on the stumps, Khan waits for it and works it across the line.
Bit shorter in length again, shoots off the deck and turns away from around off, Shan covers the line and slaps it towards the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short, turning away from around off, Masood is solid in defense as he negotiates this well.
Tossed up on off, Masood prods forward in defense.
From around the wicket now, Chase drops it on a fullish length around off, Masood kneels down to sweep but misses as it's collected by the keeper.
Spinning into Younis Khan sharply on middle and off, it's turned past FSL off the back foot for a single.
Back of a length delivery once again, it's moving away, no need to go for the those but Shan Masood wants to connect. Attempts to put bat on ball but fails to do so.
It's closer to the off stump this time, but not close enough. An easy leave for the batsman.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Masood covers the line well and shoulders his arms to it.
Inswinging full delivery from Joseph, it's turned down through backward square leg for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, a hint of shape away as Masood tries to play at this. It just about goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves.

FOUR! Length delivery in the off stump channel, Masood fishes for it and gets a thick edge. It bisects the gap between the keeper and first slip and it goes away to the boundary line. Living dangerously here, Shan Masood. Needs to be careful.
Floats it up, lands it on off, it's defended well by Younis.

Shot! Short, flat and around off, Masood rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket. It's a thick outfield which allows Gabriel to pull it back inside the rope. Three runs have been taken.
From around off, spinning away, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Quite full on middle and leg, Younis goes across, kneels down and sweeps it down towards fine leg for one more.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander, tosses it right up there, Masood leans ahead and wrists it towards Gabriel at mid on. Takes him on and completes the run with ease.
Spin and bounce for Roston Chase first up, he loops this on a length outside off, Younis Khan goes back and turns it past FSL for a single.
Roston Chase to continue from the other end.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, walks across and tucks it behind square on the leg side. Two runs taken and that'll be the end of the over.

That was in the air but just fell short. Fired full and well outside off, Masood reaches out to it and looks to drive through the covers. Gets a thick edge which falls just short of the first slip fielder. Goes through him and two runs are taken.
Excellent line this for Alzarri Joseph. On the fifth stump line, the southpaw leaves it alone.

Just back of a length, very close to the off pole, Masood initially tries playing at it but then decides to leave it. Is a little late in doing so as the ball goes off the bottom half behind on the bounce.
Slightly ahead of a length, around off, Masood plays it down off the front foot.
Starts off from around the wicket, Joseph angles it in from around off, Shan Masood moves across the line and blocks it down on the track.

Welcome back for the second session. West Indies have got some sort of momentum back by picking up two quick wickets just before lunch. Can they create further in-roads? Remains to be seen. Younis Khan walks out one last time to join Shan Masood in the middle. Alzarri Joseph to start off proceedings for the hosts. Here we go!!!
...DAY 4, AFTERNOON SESSION...

Once again it's happened, a wicket at the stroke of the break. Such has been the norm in this Test so far. West Indies' session to claim, they'll be well and truly happy as they make their way back to hog on some grub. After bowling out the hosts for less then 250, Pakistan had 'round about 30 minutes to see the session off. But Gabriel and Chase dismissed Azhar Ali and Babar Azam respectively to get the momentum in their favour. A very interesting second session awaits. Join us for it.

OUT! Chase strikes! What a delivery! Tosses up outside off, it turns in as Babar Azam presses forward to defend. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat and lobs towards short leg. The fielder, Shimron Hetmyer crouches low and takes it inches above the ground. The hosts appeal but the umpire asks them to wait. He asks some help from the third umpire but the soft signal is OUT! The TV umpire sees it from various angles and it seems like the ball bounced in front of Hetmyer. But since there is no conclusive evidence, the third umpire, Richard Kettleborough sticks with the on-field call. Babar Azam has to walk back, LUNCH DECLARED ON DAY 4!
Babar Azam is caught at short leg. The umpire has gone upstairs to check if the catch has been taken cleanly or not.
Pushes it quicker through the air, down the leg side, Babar moves inside the line to let it through.
Tosses it outside off, it turns massively down leg, Azam has got nothing to do with it.
Drags the length back around off, Masood pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, turning away, Masood doesn't offer any stroke.
Ohhhh! Turn and bounce! Sends in a flatter delivery around off, it kicks off the deck and takes Masood by surprise. The batsman pokes inside the line and gets beaten.
Roston Chase to bowl the final over before lunch.
Maiden over! Fuller again and wide outside off, Babar Azam lifts his bat to allow it to go through to the keeper.
Rolls his finger over the ball, keeps it outside off, Azam stays put to it pass.
Fuller and shaping away after pitching, BA lets it pass.
Replica of the previous ball.
In the corridor outside off, Azam shoulders his arms.
Keeps it full and outside off, Azam doesn't play at it.
Back of a length around off, defended off the back foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bit too straight as it's coming back in, it's angling down leg actually, Shan Masood looks to tickle it fine. The ball just about evades brushing the gloves as it goes behind to the keeper.
Good length ball in the off stump channel, Masood has nothing to do with that.
Straightening up after hitting the deck, outside off, left alone.
From around the wicket, Gabriel bowls it on a fuller length around off, Masood leans ahead and blocks it out solidly.
Strays on the pads, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish on middle and leg, tucked towards the man at square leg.
On a length and around off, Masood lunges forward to keep it out.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Gets across a touch and works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, it stays a bit low. Masood bunts it back down the wicket.
Stays behind the line and defends it down gently.
Babar Azam to bat at No.3.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Azhar Ali walks back, he scored a century in the first innings and now departs cheaply. The famous line will make sense here - Cricket is a great leveller! Shortish delivery, outside off, Ali slaps it hard but much to his dismay it flies towards the substitute fielder Jermaine Blackwood who takes a sharp catch near his face at point. Ali shakes his head, West Indies get a breakthrough.
Back of a length and around off, a bit of bounce as Ali stays back to defend.
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler.
Good length on off, nips back in as Masood looks to defend. He misses and the ball goes off the pads towards the keeper on the bounce.
Good length delivery, angling down leg, Ali misses to flick it away.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali slashes hard and it goes on the bounce to gully.
Short and wide outside off, Ali forces it off the back foot through covers and takes two.
Outside off, Ali doesn't play at it.
Shortish and angling in, Masood moves inside the line and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Starts off with a length delivery, coming in with the angle, Masood comes nicely forward and pushes it firmly towards mid on.
Alzarri Joseph to share the new ball with Gabriel.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Masood prods forward and works it towards square leg.
Keeps it full but it's a bit too straight, Masood gets across and flicks it straight to square leg.
Angles in a short ball on middle, Masood with no foot movement keeps it out.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Ali stays back and pushes it towards mid on for a quick single.
Beaten! Goes wide of the crease and hurls in a length delivery which nips back in a shade, Azhar pokes inside the line and is lucky not to nick one behind to the keeper.
Gabriel starts off with a shortish delivery, swinging away, Ali lets it pass through to the keeper.
